# cpanel_email_routings (Data Source)

Reads every cPanel mail domain and its configured local-delivery mode through `Email::list_mxs` without exposing MX entries or detected routing metadata.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_routings" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `routings` (Attributes List) The email routing definitions sorted by domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routings))

<a id="nestedatt--routings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routings`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The normalized mail domain.
- `mode` (String) The configured routing mode: `auto`, `local`, `backup`, or `remote`.
